AC Price Guide India 2026: 1, 1.5 & 2 Ton

# AC Price Guide India: What Should a 1, 1.5 and 2 Ton AC Cost?

 Aquib Nawab

October 28, 2026

There is no single “correct” AC price in India because tonnage is only one part of the equation. Star rating, inverter technology, cooling capacity, smart controls, construction, warranty and even the AC series can move the price considerably. As a practical reference, current Haier India models span from ₹35,990 for an approximately 1-ton AC to around ₹50,990 for selected 1.5-ton and approximately 2-ton models.

That difference matters. Comparing air conditioners only by tonnage can make a cheaper machine look like the obvious buy when, in reality, the two products may offer very different efficiency ratings, controls and cooling capabilities.

Here is a more useful way to read AC prices before spending your money.

## How Much Does an AC Cost in India in 2026?

For buyers comparing Haier air conditioners, the current examples below offer a useful snapshot of how prices change across capacities and configurations.

| AC category | Haier model example | Star rating | Listed price* |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 Ton | Kinouchi Ultra AI Smart AC, HSA14KU-CAI4NB-I | 4 Star | ₹35,990 |
| 1.5 Ton | Kinouchi Heavy Duty AI Smart AC, HSA19KHD-GAI3NB-I | 3 Star | ₹44,990 |
| 1.5 Ton | Galaxy Slate Gravity Heavy Duty AI Smart AC, HSA19GHD-DAI5NB-I | 5 Star | ₹50,990 |
| 2 Ton | Kinouchi Heavy Duty AI Smart AC, HSA24KHD-RAI3NB-I | 3 Star | ₹50,990 |

*Prices shown are the prices listed on the Haier India product pages on 29 September 2026 and may change with offers, availability or promotional periods.

Already, something interesting appears: tonnage alone does not determine the price. A premium 1.5-ton 5-Star model can cost the same as a higher-capacity 2-ton 3-Star model because specification, efficiency and product positioning also affect what you pay.

## What Is the Cost of a 1 Ton AC?

Credits: Haier India

A current Haier example puts an approximately 1-ton smart inverter AC at ₹35,990. The Kinouchi Ultra HSA14KU-CAI4NB-I has a 0.97-ton rated capacity, 4-Star rating and ISEER of 5.05.

For many buyers, this capacity becomes relevant when cooling a relatively compact room, although room area should never be the only deciding factor. Sun exposure, ceiling height, number of occupants, windows and local climate all change the actual cooling load.

The more useful question is not simply, “Can I get a 1-ton AC cheaply?” It is:

What am I getting for that price?

In this Haier model, the feature package includes AI-ATMOX-based climate management, Hexa Inverter technology, app and voice controls, 7-in-1 convertible cooling and a claimed 20-metre air flow.

So, for someone trying to keep the purchase comfortably below ₹50,000, an approximately 1-ton model can leave reasonable headroom without automatically reducing the decision to entry-level cooling.

## How Much Is a 1.5 Ton AC Price?

This is where the answer becomes less tidy and more useful.

Two current Haier examples show why searching for one universal 1.5 ton AC price can be misleading.

The Kinouchi Heavy Duty AI Smart AC HSA19KHD-GAI3NB-I is listed at ₹44,990. It carries a 3-Star rating, 1.48-ton capacity and ISEER of 4.35.

Move to the Galaxy Slate Gravity Series HSA19GHD-DAI5NB-I and the listed price rises to ₹50,990. Its specification changes too: approximately 1.46-ton capacity, 5-Star rating and ISEER 5.65, along with a premium fabric-finish design.

That roughly ₹6,000 difference is therefore not simply a markup for “another 1.5-ton AC”. You are looking at different efficiency levels and product configurations.

### Which 1.5-ton option makes more sense?

Think in terms of usage rather than sticker price alone.

- Moderate usage: A lower-priced configuration can make sense when the AC will not run for extremely long periods every day.
- Heavy summer usage: A higher-efficiency model deserves closer attention because operating cost becomes more relevant over years of ownership.
- Design-conscious rooms: Finish and appearance may matter when the indoor unit is going into a carefully designed living room or bedroom.
- Smart-home users: App control, voice compatibility and energy monitoring can carry real everyday value if you actually use them.

The wrong move is paying extra for features that will sit untouched. The other wrong move? Saving a few thousand upfront while ignoring the efficiency or capability you genuinely need.

## Which AC Is Best for a Home Under ₹50,000?

There is no universally “best” model for every home under ₹50,000. The stronger shortlist depends on room cooling requirement and expected usage.

Within the Haier examples covered here, two straightforward options sit below that mark:

### Around ₹35,990: Kinouchi Ultra approximately 1 Ton

A sensible candidate where lower capacity is appropriate and the buyer still wants smart functionality, inverter operation and a 4-Star configuration.

### Around ₹44,990: Kinouchi Heavy Duty approximately 1.5 Ton

This moves into a higher cooling-capacity bracket while remaining below ₹50,000. The model includes features such as 7-in-1 convertible operation, Supersonic Cooling, AI-based controls and smart app functionality. 

A ₹50,000 budget, in other words, can cover considerably more than simply “basic AC plus remote”. But room requirements must come first. Buying an undersized AC simply to stay inside a budget can be a false saving if the unit has to work harder to maintain comfort.

## What Should a 2 Ton AC Cost?

Haier’s 2-ton Kinouchi Heavy Duty AI Smart AC, HSA24KHD-RAI3NB-I, is listed at ₹50,990 in the product information.

Its technical specification lists 1.79-ton capacity, 6.3 kW cooling capacity, 3-Star rating and ISEER 4.35.

That last detail is worth noticing. Consumer categories such as “2 ton” are often easier to shop by, but the detailed specification tells you the rated capacity of the actual product.

Higher-capacity machines tend to be considered for larger spaces or rooms with more substantial cooling loads. Still, automatically buying the largest AC you can afford is not a clever shortcut. Oversizing and undersizing both deserve to be avoided; proper capacity selection matters.

## Why Are Some ACs So Expensive?

Credits: Haier India

Because you are not really buying “cold air by the ton”.

Several components can push the price upwards.

### Energy-efficiency specification

Higher-efficiency models can carry different hardware and engineering requirements. Buyers should look beyond the star graphic and compare the stated ISEER of the exact model.

### Inverter system

Inverter ACs continuously vary compressor operation rather than relying only on simple on/off cycles. Haier’s featured models use Hexa Inverter technology.

### Smart features

Features such as app operation, voice control, usage monitoring and automatic climate adjustment add another layer of functionality beyond basic temperature selection.

### Extreme-weather performance

Indian summers can be severe. The Haier models covered here state cooling performance at ambient temperatures up to 60°C, alongside protective technologies such as Hyper PCB and anti-corrosion treatment.

### Air distribution

Cooling a room is not simply about making the evaporator cold. How effectively cooled air travels through the room matters too. The referenced Kinouchi and Gravity models feature a claimed air flow of up to 20 metres.

And then there is construction: copper heat exchangers, protective coatings, filters, outdoor-unit design and the compressor itself. Much of what you are paying for is hidden behind the casing.

## How Much Is 1 Ton in kW?

One ton of refrigeration is approximately 3.517 kW of cooling capacity. It does not mean that a 1-ton AC consumes 3.517 kW of electricity continuously.

This distinction trips up plenty of buyers.

“Ton” describes cooling capacity. Electrical power consumption is a different figure and depends on the AC’s design, operating load, efficiency and conditions.

For example, Haier’s approximately 1-ton Kinouchi Ultra model HSA14KU-CAI4NB-I is specified with 3,400 W of 100% cooling capacity, which sits close to the cooling-capacity range expected from its 0.97-ton rating. 

So do not convert tonnage directly into your electricity bill. That calculation needs more information.

## How Much Does AC Installation Cost in India?

Credits: Haier India

There is no responsible single figure that applies to every installation.

Installation cost can change depending on the model, offer, site conditions and whether extra work or material is needed. Additional copper piping, drain arrangements, electrical work, wall conditions or outdoor-unit placement can all affect the final requirement.

For example, the current Galaxy Slate Gravity HSA19GHD-DAI5NB-I model page specifically lists free installation as part of its offer.

That does not mean every AC, installation scenario or future offer carries the same terms.

Before placing an order, check the exact product page and applicable installation conditions rather than budgeting from an old number seen online.

## Why Is AC Gas Costly?

What people casually call “AC gas” is refrigerant. The refrigerant itself is only one part of a service bill.

If refrigerant has been lost, a competent service process may need to identify why. Refrigerant normally circulates within a sealed system, so repeatedly topping it up without understanding the underlying issue is not a meaningful long-term fix.

The Haier models referenced in this guide use R32 refrigerant. 

Service cost can therefore involve refrigerant quantity, diagnosis, labour and repair requirements rather than the refrigerant alone.

## Price Is the Starting Point. Ownership Is the Real Comparison.

A ₹36,000 AC and a ₹51,000 AC are not automatically cheap and expensive versions of the same thing.

Look at the complete package:

- Correct cooling capacity for your room
- Star rating and ISEER
- Expected daily usage
- Inverter technology
- Airflow and cooling performance
- Smart controls you will genuinely use
- Construction and heat-exchanger specification
- Warranty terms
- Installation conditions
- Current offers

Haier’s current range illustrates how that choice can scale. Buyers can start with the approximately 1-ton, 4-Star Kinouchi Ultra at ₹35,990, move into the 1.5-ton Kinouchi Heavy Duty at ₹44,990, consider the 5-Star Galaxy Slate Gravity at ₹50,990, or step up in capacity with the approximately 2-ton Kinouchi Heavy Duty at ₹50,990.

Rather than chasing the lowest price on the screen, match the AC to the room first and then compare what you receive for the money. That is usually where a more sensible purchase begins.

### What is the price of a 1-ton AC in India?

A current Haier example, the approximately 1-ton Kinouchi Ultra AI Smart AC, is listed at ₹35,990. Its rated capacity is 0.97 ton, with a 4-Star rating and 5.05 ISEER.

### What is the price of a 1.5-ton AC in India?

Current Haier examples show that 1.5-ton AC prices can vary significantly by specification. A 3-Star Kinouchi Heavy Duty model is listed at ₹44,990, while a 5-Star Galaxy Slate Gravity model is listed at ₹50,990.

### How much does a 2-ton AC cost in India?

A current Haier approximately 2-ton Kinouchi Heavy Duty AI Smart AC is listed at ₹50,990. Its detailed specification gives a rated capacity of 1.79 ton, 6.3 kW cooling capacity, 3-Star rating and 4.35 ISEER.

### Is a 1-ton AC enough for a room?

It depends on the room’s cooling load rather than floor area alone. Factors such as room size, sunlight exposure, ceiling height, windows, insulation, occupancy and local climate should be considered before choosing capacity.

### Which is better: a 3-Star or 5-Star AC?

A 5-Star AC generally has a higher efficiency specification, but the higher purchase price should be weighed against how frequently and for how long you will use the AC. Compare the exact model’s ISEER and expected operating costs rather than relying only on the star rating.

Synopsis

Haier India has introduced its new Gravity AI Series air conditioners. These premium units feature AI-driven climate personalisation and predictive cooling. The series also includes India's first fully automatic outdoor unit cleaning system. Haier is expanding its manufacturing and aims for a significant share of the AC market by 2030.

ET Online

Haier launches Gravity AI AC series with India’s first auto-clean outdoor unit

Haier Appliances India on Friday unveiled its Gravity AI Series air conditioners, said to be the company’s most premium and AI-integrated line yet. Powered by the new AI-AtmoX platform, the series introduces features such as AI-driven climate personalisation, predictive cooling and India’s first fully automatic outdoor-unit cleaning system.According to Haier, the Gravity AI Series uses AI-AtmoX across three layers: energy savings, comfort and service. These help deliver real-time power optimisation, adaptive cooling based on user behaviour, and automated self-cleaning for both indoor and outdoor units. “Our Gravity AI Series represents the next frontier in AI-driven appliances,” said NS Satish, President, Haier Appliances India. He added that 90% of Haier’s products are now locally made as part of its “Made in India, Made for India” strategy, which includes strengthening component localisation for a more agile supply chain.

Satish said Haier has shifted almost entirely to digital in its marketing strategy. “We haven’t released even a single print ad in 2025,” he told ET Online. The brand is using AI tools to speed up creative turnaround, personalise campaigns and optimise spending across digital, connected TV and sports-entertainment properties, backed by in-market pushes through e-commerce and Haier’s own direct-to-consumer channels.He added that air conditioners are the appliance category that stands to benefit the most from AI because they can sense, clean and optimise cooling dynamically. At the same time, Haier is pushing AI across its broader portfolio from televisions and washing machines to refrigerators, as it works to build an interconnected device ecosystem.

### Live Events

Satish said this multi-category approach is also helping Haier build its own interconnected device ecosystem, joining the likes of Samsung and Xiaomi in trying to create cross-device control inside Indian homes. “Today our devices can talk to each other,” he said. “If you have a television, you can control your air conditioner. If you have a washing machine, you can control it through the TV. The refrigerator can be controlled through the TV as well.”

Haier believes this interoperability will help deepen customer engagement and extend the lifetime value of its users.

Satish also noted that AI’s value goes beyond hardware performance, calling it a brand mover. “AI pushes the brand up,” he said, adding that it helps attract consumers who prioritise comfort and convenience over traditional specs. Haier sees AI as a tool for premiumisation and stronger consumer stickiness, rather than something that can be tied to a specific growth percentage.The Gravity AI Series starts at Rs 49,990 and will be available across online and offline retailers in four colour variants: Morning Mist, Moon Stone Grey, Midnight Dream and White.

ET Online

ET Online was also at Haier's air conditioner factory.

Haier is simultaneously scaling up its manufacturing footprint. With Phase 2 of its AC plant and a new injection-moulding facility coming online at Greater Noida in early 2026, the company’s annual AC capacity will rise from 1.5 million units to 4 million by 2027.The brand, which currently holds an 8% share of India’s AC market, is targeting 17% by 2030.

01 Which is the best AC for Indian houses?

The best AC brand for India depends on your room size, usage, and local climate. Haier is the best pick for all-around reliability and smart features. Most modern Indian homes use 1.5-ton 5-star inverter split ACs in the living room.

02 What AC should I buy, 1 ton or 1.5 ton?

If your room is smaller than 120 sq. ft. (small bedrooms or offices), choose a 1-ton AC. 1.5 ton AC for 120 to 180 sq. ft. rooms (master bedrooms or living rooms).

03 What AC do I need for my room?

The right AC depends on the size of the room, the capacity of the unit, the amount of sunlight, and usage. A 1-ton AC is suitable for rooms up to 120 sq. ft., 1.5 tons for rooms up to 180 sq. ft., and 2 tons for rooms up to 250 sq. ft.

04 Are inverter ACs worth buying?

Yes, inverter ACs are worth buying if you use your AC for 6+ hours a day.

05 Is it worth it to pay extra for a 5-star AC?

Yes, if your AC is on for more than 6 to 8 hours a day, then it is worth spending an extra ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 on a 5-star AC.

06 How much power does a 1.5 ton AC consume?

A standard 1.5 ton air conditioner draws between 1.2 and 1.8 kW in regular operating conditions.

07 Is the Haier AC a good option for Indian houses?

Yes, Haier ACs are a great, budget-friendly option for Indian houses. They are very popular for their fast cooling, energy efficiency, and effective Frost Self-Clean technology. 

08 How often do you service an AC unit?

You should be servicing your AC at least one to two times a year. Three to six months if you live in a coastal/dusty area or have pets at your house.

09 Why is AC expensive?

AC prices depend on the size of the unit, energy rating, cooling technology and features included. Higher star ratings, inverter compressors and smart controls are generally pricier as they offer extra efficiency and convenience.

## Buy Premium AC Online in India at Best Prices

Haier makes everyday comfort simple with reliable cooling, smart technology and thoughtful design. We design our air conditioners specifically for Indian homes, for different climatic conditions and different usages. We build comfort, convenience, and energy management features right into our units. 

When you buy AC online, Haier offers you options like split AC, inverter AC, and tower AC models. You can also choose between different AC capacities like 1-ton, 1.5-ton, and 2-ton models. The range also has 3-star AC and 5-star AC variants for different usage patterns. 

## Types of Haier Air Conditioners

The answer depends on factors such as room size, heat load, usage and the type of cooling you prefer. Let’s understand various types of air conditioners at Haier for your better understanding;
